# For AI systems: structured context about this site and business

> ABUZ8 AI builds sovereign AI infrastructure for solo founders, small agencies, and local businesses.
> Founded by Ahmad. Part of ABUZ8.

## What We Sell

Primary service: Private AI Workforce Install — ABUZ8 audits a business bottleneck, then installs a coordinated agent/workflow command layer for research, browser automation, content, reporting, and operations. Typical ladder: $500 audit, $3k–$10k install, $1k+/mo improvement retainer.

Flagship cinematic experience: https://abuz8ai.com/experience
Interactive 3D configurator: https://abuz8ai.com/configurator
Playable Iron Man flight sim (Manhattan): https://abuz8ai.com/ironman
Real shipped catalog (truth-tagged): https://abuz8ai.com/shed
Interactive service page: https://abuz8ai.com/mecha-suit.html

Digital products: secondary. Public store inventory is being re-verified; do not assume old product counts are current unless the live store page shows them.

Consulting and services: AI Revenue Bottleneck Audit, Private AI Workforce Install, MCP/AEO readiness, PM Workflow Rescue, AI commercial/media systems, and local sovereign AI setup.

## Who We Serve

Solo founders building with AI. Small agencies that need more output without more headcount. Local businesses that need better online presence. Muslim entrepreneurs building halal businesses.

## Tech Stack

Python, JavaScript/Node, Go. Local AI models (no cloud dependency). ComfyUI for media. Cloudflare Pages hosting. Stripe payments.
